as_told.title: Anderson's colleague at Area 51 also saw the green orb
as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana; Area 51

plain: Randy Anderson, a former military man who says he saw alien technology at a base, says that during training at the Nevada test range a green, ball-shaped object flew over and a buddy of his saw it. Later a podcast host, Jesse Michels, said a colleague who still works with Anderson at Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, confirmed seeing that green orb, and Michels pointed to Anderson's DD214, the US military's discharge paper, as backing for his service. If true, it would mean unknown objects fly over one of America's most guarded places.
